instructionSummary:
Create a tool similar to canva. Here I need to do video, image, presentation generation and editing. It is a heavy tool with multi functionalities. Make sure to generate canva equivalent functionalities. Prompt generation, video generation etc use OpenAI and have an agentic solution to pull hugging face models to generate features. use the Media Archive to get the UI functionalities for reference. Make it complex tool design software web solution not a simple app.

New project media references staged before creation:
- Archive.zip (application/zip)

Branding colours: SaaS Momentum (#293681, #4274D9, #95CCD0, #DDE7E6). Recommended for software, ai. Use these as brand direction while maintaining accessible text/background contrast.
